Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed Q3 bridge offer for Meridian Health (RDW-DEAL-2026-0915-892)

Team — quick thread to get a decision.

Context: Meridian is in evaluation with a production pilot due to start next quarter. They’re stalled on final sign-off (procurement asking for a single-line SOW and an internal PO) and we’re at the last week of Q3. HubSpot shows strong usage during trial and high intent.

Proposal (what I’d like to offer as a last-mile incentive):
- One-time platform credit: $45,000 to be applied to usage (valid 90 days from issue)
- Trial window extended to 2026-12-31 (previously 2026-10-15)
- Conditional conversion discount: 10% off first 6 months if they convert within 120 days

Why this makes sense: higher likelihood of conversion, keeps usage on our platform (prefers Redwood Dedicated later), and aligns with their ask for better visibility on initial costs.

Asks: can we greenlight this amount? If approved I’ll send an offer to Lena with a DocuSign link and a short SOW attachment. I’ve attached the SOW draft and our Q3 price sheet.

If you have alternative structures (e.g., smaller top-up + extended term or milestone-based credit), call it out — we have until EOD Wednesday to get this into procurement.

Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198

Tessa — good framing. I support an aggressive hand to close. A couple of tactical suggestions:

1) Split the credit into two buckets: $30k usage credit + $15k onboarding services credit (applied to professional services) — helps legal & finance track usage vs services.
2) Make the conversion discount layered: 10% first 3 months, then 5% next 3 months if they sign within 120 days.
3) Add a simple clause: credits expire if they self-terminate before conversion (protects against churn).

If you want me to, I’ll loop in FinOps (Marissa) to confirm we can issue $45k one-off and that it won't complicate our quarter close. Otherwise go ahead and send the external offer; copy CS on the SOW.

—Marcus
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Best,
